name: Log cleaner for Kadence Security
author: Rocket Apps

sections.description:
In early 2018, the ability to delete logs from the database was removed from iThemes Security, now known as Kadence Security. This plugin gives you that control back.

Works with Kadence Security, plus older versions released as Solid Security and iThemes Security.

Support

Log cleaner for Kadence Security Support at the official WordPress repository.

How to use

  • Go to Tools -> Kadence Security Log Cleaner (on multisite, find Kadence Security Log Cleaner in the Network Admin menu)
  • Select which logs to delete (or select ‘All’)
  • Hit the Clear logs button
  • Get on with the rest of your day (optional)

Note: This plugin comes with no warranty of any kind.

Uninstall

Deactivate the plugin, delete if desired.
